devices.name: NanoSense - AAQ
devices.description: Atmospheric/outdoor air quality probe (LoRaWAN Class A): temperature, humidity, PM10/PM2.5/PM1, noise, 3 electrochemical gas channels (NOX/NO2/O3/H2S/SO2/NH3), battery status

devices.name: NanoSense - E4000-NG
devices.description: Indoor air quality probe E4000-NG (LoRaWAN Class A): CO2, temperature, humidity, VOC, PM10/PM2.5/PM1, occupancy and window states

devices.name: NanoSense - EP5000
devices.description: IAQ room multi-sensor EP5000 family (LoRaWAN): CO2, TVOC, formaldehyde, benzene, sulphurous odors, PM10/PM2.5/PM1, temperature, humidity, noise, atmospheric pressure, lux, light color temperature, flickering and physiological indices

devices.name: NanoSense - EP5000MML
devices.description: IAQ room multi-sensor EP5000MML-N (Multi-Measurement LoRaWAN variant of the EP5000 family): CO2, TVOC, sulphurous odors, PM10/PM2.5/PM1, temperature, humidity, noise, atmospheric pressure, lux, light color temperature and physiological indices (same 37-byte telegram as EP5000)

devices.name: NanoSense - QAA
devices.description: Atmospheric air quality probe QAA (LoRaWAN Class A), same telegram as the AAQ: temperature, humidity, PM10/PM2.5/PM1, noise, 3 electrochemical gas channels, battery status
